item.title: Mini Crackme: x86-64 (Windows)
item.description:
Find the 32-bit value that must be passed in ecx for `check` to return 1.
check: mov eax, ecx xor eax, 5Ah cmp eax, 1Ah jne fail mov eax, 1 ret fail: xor eax, eax ret
Answer: ecx = 0x40 (64 decimal).
1. eax is loaded with ecx, then XOR'd with 0x5A; the branch only avoids fail when that result equals 0x1A. 2. So we need ecx ^ 0x5A == 0x1A. XOR is its own inverse, so ecx = 0x1A ^ 0x5A = 0x40. 3. With ecx = 0x40, eax becomes 0x1A, the cmp/jne falls through, and eax is set to 1 before ret.
